title: backend-skeleton feature record (specs/<feature_id>/feature.json)
description: D6 (D-feature-lifecycle): first real schema for this file -- previously unvalidated. archived_at/archived_reason are new, added alongside `bskel feature archive`.

archived_at.description: set by `bskel feature archive` -- a soft-delete marker, not a filesystem move. Present iff archived_reason is.

archived_reason.description: required alongside archived_at -- every archive is auditable, matching this project's --force/--reason convention elsewhere (O2, S4).
